generation.explanation: A radian measures an angle by comparing the length of its circular arc to the circle’s radius: θ = arc length ÷ radius. One radian is the angle that cuts off an arc exactly as long as the radius—about 57.3°. Drag the yellow point to see the arc length and angle grow together; a full turn is 2π radians.
